verdict.label: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
verdict.reasoning_summary:
The claim states that Walmart's total revenues for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased year over year. This would require comparing Q3 FY2027 (ended October 31, 2026) to Q3 FY2026 (ended October 31, 2025).

The evidence provided does not contain financial data for the quarter ended October 31, 2026. The most recent quarterly filing in the evidence is the 10-Q filed on August 28, 2026 for the period ended July 31, 2026 (Q2 FY2027). The 10-K filed on March 13, 2026 covers the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026.

Evidence E6 shows revenues for quarters ended July 31, 2026 and July 31, 2025, but this is for Q2, not Q3. There is no evidence showing revenues for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 or comparing it to the quarter ended October 31, 2025.

Since the evidence does not cover the specific reporting period (Q3 FY2027 ended October 31, 2026) mentioned in the claim, there is insufficient evidence to verify whether total revenues increased year over year for that quarter.

By leading on price, we earn the trust of our customers every day by providing a broad assortment of quality merchandise and services at everyday low prices ("EDLP"). EDLP is our pricing philosophy under which we price items at a low price every day so our customers trust that our prices will not change under frequent promotional activity. Everyday low cost ("EDLC") is our commitment to control expenses so our cost savings can be passed along to our customers. Our operations comprise three reportable segments: Walmart U.S., Walmart International and Sam's Club U.S. Our fiscal year ends on January 31 for our United States ("U.S.") and Canadian operations. We consolidate all other operations generally using a one-month lag and on a calendar year basis. Our discussion is as of, and for the fiscal years ended, January 31, 2026 ("fiscal 2026"), January 31, 2025 ("fiscal 2025") and January 31, 2024 ("fiscal 2024"). During fiscal 2026, we generated total revenues of $713.2 billion, which primarily comprised net sales of $706.4 billion. We maintain our principal offices in Bentonville, Arkansas.
